next_action: W-001: Copy the census-located legacy files onto a reachable drive (yours; unblocks 4)

A-001.title: Objective metrics that track recording quality as an implant ages
A-001.scope: seven animals (Chase, Luigi, Oops, Picasso, Rocky I1+I2, Nigel, Fisk), three acquisition regimes, >1,100 analyzed session-arrays 2013-2025, Utah 96ch primary
A-001.body:
Success criterion: a three-layer metric stack (threshold-crossing, per-sorter
quality, multi-sorter agreement) validated longitudinally across the cohort and
at least two probe types, with the agreement *structure* reported as the
headline longitudinal metric.
Approach: scratch-first SpikeInterface pipeline; per-session computation under
the aggregation rule (D-002); snippet and continuous regimes handled as equals
(D-003); consensus never collapsed to a single sorting.

A-002.title: Re-examine the published L1-coating yield claim on the full cohort
A-002.scope: four whole-array L1 animals, two striped animals (four arrays, 10 stripes/condition), one TNP vs TNP-L1 pair (Rocky I2)
A-002.body:
Success criterion: the coating effect separated from pedestal-position and
animal/implant confounds, or explicitly bounded by the designs available.
Approach: pair inside the session; use the cohort's own deconfounds (opposite
coating-to-pedestal arrangements across animals, within-array stripes, a
fourth arrangement on Rocky I2). Current state: only the pedestal axis is
consistent (R-010); stripes rule out >~22% pooled (R-006).

A-003.title: A pipeline a new student can run end to end, MATLAB-consumable
A-003.scope: src/recqual package + parallel MATLAB layer; nothing promoted from notebooks yet
A-003.body:
Success criterion: `src/recqual` modules with Tier-1 tests, phase tutorials,
and NPY/JSON/Parquet outputs a MATLAB layer consumes without pickle.
Approach: scratch-first, promote at phase boundaries. Nothing is promoted yet
(W-007, W-008); every analysis so far lives in notebooks/scratch_*.py.

D-001.title: Read the band from the nsX extended header, never from the suffix
D-001.summary: Both suffix conventions are wrong here; 498/626 continuous files are high-passed
D-001.body:
Context: suffix conventions implied .ns5=broadband, .ns3=LFP.
Options: trust suffixes; read hi/lo_freq_corner (millihertz) per file.
Choice: header always; both suffix conventions were checked and both are wrong
on this corpus (498/626 continuous files are 250 Hz high-passed).
Consequences: LFP derivable only from Fisk .ns6; per-subject filter work
differs and must be checked before cross-animal comparisons.

D-002.title: Never pool numerator and denominator across sessions; pair within session
D-002.summary: Pooled ratios mis-stated findings by 661x and 5.1x; one produced a confident wrong conclusion
D-002.body:
Context: session sizes span two orders of magnitude; pooled ratios are
statements about the largest sessions (measured 661x and 5.1x distortions, one
producing a confident wrong conclusion).
Options: pooled ratios; per-session ratio then median; mixed.
Choice: per-session then median; pair inside the session where a pair exists.
Consequences: every campaign since (treatment, rings, impedance) is built on
per-session medians and within-session pairing.

D-003.title: Snippet-only cohorts are sorted per-electrode (ISO-SPLIT), as the correct method
D-003.summary: At 400 um pitch a neuron appears on one electrode; per-electrode clustering is the correct method
D-003.body:
Context: the standard pool needs continuous traces; much of the estate is
snippet-only NEV.
Options: skip snippet eras; pretend snippets feed sorters; per-electrode
clustering with an explicit physics gate.
Choice: per-electrode ISO-SPLIT on PCA features - at 400 um pitch a neuron
appears on one electrode, so this is the correct method there, not a fallback.
Consequences: two-regime pipeline; snippet results carry their own methods
suffixes and gate.

D-004.title: Do not use UnitRefine on snippet data; the physics gate is the curation layer
D-004.summary: Seven required features need continuous traces; imputing them saturates the classifier at noise
D-004.body:
Context: UnitRefine labels 99.98% of 65,051 snippet units noise; seven of its
features need continuous traces.
Options: threshold-shift the classifier; impute features; ban it on snippets.
Choice: ban on snippets; explicit SNR/count/shape gate instead. Scope-narrowed
by R-004: on recording-backed analyzers the models are usable.
Consequences: contradicts CLAUDE.md's stated default curation policy for the
snippet arm; ur_* columns in curation_labels are not to be used.

D-005.title: Resolve array serials by (subject, implant, array), never (subject, array)
D-005.summary: Rocky's implants reuse array labels; the collapsed key mislabelled 431 sessions
D-005.body:
Context: Rocky's two implants reuse the Anterior/Posterior labels; a collapsed
key let I2 overwrite I1 (I-001).
Options: keep collapsed key and special-case Rocky; key by implant everywhere.
Choice: implant in the key, taken from the session row; helpers fixed at four
sites, tables repaired.
Consequences: any future subject with reimplants is safe by construction.

D-006.title: Blackrock impedance joins recordings on channel_id (proven 1248/1248)
D-006.summary: The factory workbook's elecN row headers are a misnomer; rows are channel-indexed, proven 1248/1248
D-006.body:
Context: the factory workbook's rows are headed elec1..128, a misnomer.
Options: join on electrode number; join on channel id.
Choice: channel id - proved exactly (1,248/1,248 positions across 13 arrays);
joining on electrode number yields a complete, plausible, permuted table.
Consequences: Fisk's Cerebus impedance is map-free; only the potentiostat
chain needs D-011.

D-007.title: Fisk's .ns3 stays out of the pipeline
D-007.summary: A 300 Hz high-passed band-limited copy of the .ns6; one sampled file all-zero
D-007.body:
Context: 140 sessions of a second 2 kHz stream, suffix suggests LFP.
Options: ingest as LFP; ingest as a second spike-band stream; exclude.
Choice: exclude - it is a 300 Hz high-passed band-limited copy of the .ns6
(R-008), and one sampled file is all-zero.
Consequences: Fisk LFP derives from .ns6 alone; no ns3 code paths.

D-008.title: Stripes run along CMP col; even cols carry L1; Nigel anterior is TNP (owner-confirmed)
D-008.summary: The schematic panels beat the transposed implant table; owner ruled anterior = TNP
D-008.body:
Context: the treatment schematic and the CMP use different orientations; the
implant table contradicts the schematic panels.
Options: row-parity split (the naive reading); col-parity; trust the table.
Choice: col-parity with even=L1, anchored by the schematic panels reproducing
each array's unconnected positions exactly; the implant table is transposed -
owner confirmed 2026-08-19 that anterior is TNP.
Consequences: Nigel verified from its own maps; Fisk carried by design
inference only (Q-001).

D-009.title: Potentiostat open/short flags are measurement-chain diagnostics, not electrode states
D-009.summary: Potentiostat opens sit at ephys percentile ~0.5 under every candidate map
D-009.body:
Context: impedance QC carries frac_open/frac_short; the map-validation plan
assumed an open electrode is a dead ephys channel.
Options: treat opens as electrode deaths; treat them as chain faults.
Choice: chain faults - opens sit at ephys percentile ~0.5 under every candidate
map (R-003), so they do not replicate through the recording chain.
Consequences: the open/short map-validation idea is retired; QC flags read as
rig health.

D-010.title: Min_P2P_exclusion = 20 uV is not applied anywhere unless explicitly requested
D-010.summary: Owner's standing ruling, chat-only provenance; never apply the legacy threshold silently
source: chat 2026-08 (standing instruction; not recorded in repo files)
D-010.body:
Context: a legacy exclusion threshold exists in the MATLAB layer's history.
Options: apply it for comparability; never apply it silently.
Choice: standing instruction from the owner - never apply unless explicitly
asked. Basis is inferred because the instruction lives only in chat; created
date approximate.
Consequences: all yield/amplitude tables are unfiltered by P2P.

D-011.title: Adopt the authored potentiostat channel map over the naive sweep-order map
D-011.summary: Candidates agree on 0/96 channels; three empirical arbiters null, so a documentary call
D-011.body:
Context: the two candidate maps agree on 0/96 channels; every per-electrode
impedance conclusion depends on the choice. Owner said "we will validate
together".
Options: authored (lab mapping sheets; four internal checks pass); naive
(sweep order; no provenance); either reversed.
Choice: pending the owner. Three empirical arbiters are null (R-003), so the
decision rests on documentary evidence alone - the authored map's provenance
against the naive map's nothing.
Consequences when accepted: unblocks W-004 (per-electrode joins) and firms the
Rocky edge-widening interpretation (R-007).

D-012.title: The nav ledger is the project's navigation system; NAV.html supersedes the dashboards
D-012.summary: Cross-session memory lives in nav/entries; STATE.md is the orientation page; generated files are never hand-edited
D-012.body:
Context: the pilot (2026-09-12) showed the hand-built dashboards freeze and
drift while docs/notes stay current; the owner directed running Test A.
Options: keep hand-curated dashboards; adopt the ledger with generated views.
Choice: schema v0.2 ledger in nav/entries, nav.py generating STATE.md /
DELTA.md / NAV.html, hooks printing the brief at session start and closing
out before compaction. session_map.html and recqual_flow.html move to
nav/legacy as records.
Consequences: file-as-you-go becomes part of normal work (CLAUDE.md
snippet); telemetry runs for the steady-state test window.

I-001.title: 431 Rocky I1 sessions carried I2 serials (collapsed lookup key)
I-001.body:
Four scripts collapsed serials across implants; ns5_free/ns5_sorters labels and
the sorters' CMP geometry were wrong for Rocky I1. Values unaffected
(geometry-free metrics); position-dependent readings of those sorts remain
untrustworthy until re-run. Fixed by D-005; tables repaired.

I-002.title: Navigation documents lag the project by weeks (roadmap pointer, HANDOFF, cross_subject open items, artifacts)
I-002.summary: All four stale documents fixed or superseded on 2026-09-13
I-002.body:

HANDOFF.md predates the cross-subject pivot; cross_subject_plan par.4 lists as
open two questions answered weeks ago (I2 in scope; Nigel's 2456 = ejected
array); the two published dashboards are frozen at 2026-08-22/23. Resolution is

Resolved 2026-09-13: roadmap's current-state pointer rewritten (points to
nav/STATE.md, S14 position, nav-queue next actions); HANDOFF.md carries a
superseded-as-orientation banner; cross_subject_plan par.4 annotated (two
answered, one moot, two still open as Q-004/Q-007); the two dashboards are
superseded by NAV.html and moved to nav/legacy/ (D-012, W-011 re-scoped for
the still-published copies).

P-06.body: Unchanged from the roadmap; gated on the earlier phases closing (W-014).

P-07.body:
Nominally deferred, in practice one of the most active threads: chronic records

P-08.title: Endpoint histology registration (with imaging as a later sibling)
P-08.body:
The NEUN peri-implant pipeline exists in a sibling session (session13 log,

In vivo imaging registration is folded here as a later sibling rather than a

Q-001.title: Is Fisk's stripe assignment (carried from Nigel by design) correct?
Q-001.prediction: the by-location workbook confirms even-col L1 on both Fisk arrays
Q-001.falsifier: the workbook's stripe-resolved layout contradicts col-parity or its phase
Q-001.body:
Nigel's assignment is verified from its own schematic maps; Fisk's maps match
neither panel, so its half of the 0/168 stripe null rests on design inference.
'Nigel and Fisk compiled results by location20260211.xlsx' (census-located)
encodes the assignment directly. Answering re-grounds W-003.

Q-002.title: What sets the implant-level ephys edge sign?
Q-002.prediction: insertion mechanics / perimeter trauma at implantation, fixed per implant
Q-002.falsifier: a sign flip within one implant over time absent any surgical event
Q-002.body:
Same animal, same geometry, opposite signs across implants (R-002). Histology
at explant (P-08, W-006) is the most direct discriminator available to this
project.

Q-003.title: Does the acquired impedance edge effect appear in a second map-free animal (Nigel)?
Q-003.prediction: Nigel's 362 impedance files show border below interior, widening with age
Q-003.falsifier: flat or positive border contrast across Nigel's record
Q-003.body: Fisk is the only map-free animal so far; Rocky corroborates through a disputed map (R-007).

Q-004.title: What probe do Picasso and Luigi actually carry?
Q-004.prediction: Utah 96 for both (assumed throughout the legacy material)
Q-004.falsifier: a datasheet or cmp naming a different geometry
Q-004.body:
No .cmp or 1025- serial anywhere in the census for either animal. Spatial
analysis for the TDT era stays blocked regardless while the TDT channel map is
unmapped. Owner external: only the drive estate or lab records can answer.

Q-005.title: Why do Picasso recordings continue past the documented pedestal failures?
Q-005.prediction: label reuse or failure-date error rather than recording through a failed pedestal
Q-005.falsifier: session content proving live cortex through the failed pedestal after its failure date
Q-005.body: The one cohort-definition contradiction never resolved; a wrong failure date would shift the longitudinal framing for Picasso.

Q-006.title: Does a coating effect exist below the ~22% pooled detection bound?
Q-006.trigger: more striped arrays or animals enter the estate
Q-006.prediction: if any effect exists it is under 10% and direction-inconsistent across substrates
Q-006.falsifier: a larger striped cohort resolving a consistent >10% effect
Q-006.body: Wake trigger: more striped arrays or animals enter the estate. The binding constraint is five stripes per condition, not sessions.

Q-007.title: How deep can Luigi's analysis go given no impedance, no map, and 148 undated tanks?
Q-007.prediction: session-level yield trends only; nothing per-electrode is recoverable
Q-007.falsifier: a recovered probe map or pinout making per-electrode work possible
Q-007.body: The +31-day clock correction dated the tanks; the channel map remains excluded (24/24 candidates), and amplifier-bound noise says it may be unrecoverable in principle.

Q-008.title: Does the agreement structure track recording quality better than single-sorter counts?
Q-008.prediction: the consensus ladder is the more specific longitudinal metric, especially near array death
Q-008.falsifier: ladder trends no more predictive of independent quality markers (impedance, yield collapse) than raw counts
Q-008.body:
The project's headline bet, stated as policy in CLAUDE.md but never phrased as
a testable claim - filed as the hypothesis it is. R-001's death signatures are
the first supporting evidence.

R-001.title: Four-sorter agreement is uniform (0.27-0.34) and collapses exactly on dying arrays
R-001.body:
What ran: 48 era-spanning stems x 4 sorters, agreement graph per stem.
Outcome: median pairwise match 0.27-0.34 on every array incl. Rocky I2; dead
arrays give 36->1->0->0 and 210->1->1->0 ladders; declines land on the arrays
that died (Nigel Ant rho -0.83, Rocky I1 Post -0.89).
Interpretation: the consensus ladder is a spike-validity metric no single
sorter provides; count-based dispersion proxies are retired as trends.

R-002.title: Rocky I2 (fresh) has border 26-38% below interior; I1 ran the opposite way
R-002.body:
What ran: per-electrode events for 20 I2 sessions; ring/border/within-bank.
Outcome: all 16 within-bank cells negative, isotropy 4/4 on 6/8 array-metrics;
I1 in the same animal ran +16 to +55%.
Interpretation: the ephys edge sign is implant-level, not geometric and not
animal-level - the deconfound is now within-animal. Feeds Q-002.

R-003.title: Three empirical channel-map arbiters (bench x2 animals, open/short, border) are null
R-003.body:
What ran: bench-vs-factory within-half Spearman on Rocky and Picasso
pre-implant sweeps (4 candidate orderings), the open/short ephys test, and the
border contrast over 52 dates.
Outcome: all at chance; border negative under every candidate (shared bank-half
component).
Interpretation: the ordering cannot be settled empirically with existing data;
D-011 rests on documentary evidence. Also grounds D-009.

R-004.title: UnitRefine is discriminative on recording-backed analyzers (54-68% neural)
R-004.body:
What ran: full-feature analyzers (35/37 real) on two retained Fisk stems; both
classifiers driven with the sklearn-1.4 imputer patch.
Outcome: 88/129 and 147/272 neural with plausible SNR ordering, against 0.02%
on snippets.
Interpretation: the snippet failure was the input representation, as
hypothesised; the continuous arm can use UnitRefine (W-012 validates it).

R-005.title: Coated array sits ~2x higher impedance on 18/19 chronic paired dates, flipping with pedestal
R-005.body:
What ran: Oops (12 dates) and Picasso (25 dates) chronic potentiostat records,
array-level medians (ordering-independent).
Outcome: Oops posterior-coated -0.347 dex 10/10 dates; Picasso anterior-coated
+0.282 dex 8/9 dates.
Interpretation: independent within-chronic confirmation of the cohort
definition's coating assignments.

R-006.title: Pooled four-array stripe permutation: null; detectable bound 21.7% yield / 5.5% noise
R-006.body:
What ran: one shared L1 term across the four striped arrays, null redrawn
per-array (20k draws).
Outcome: yield -7.5% on L1 stripes, p=0.52; bound tightens from ~30% per array
to 21.7% pooled.
Interpretation: no detectable coating effect at the sensitivity this cohort
allows; Q-006 holds what remains.

R-007.title: Rocky's impedance edge contrast widens from its bench value over 7 years
R-007.body:
What ran: 52-date chronic record (16 missing 2019-2021 dates ingested) with
pre-implant bench anchors, authored map.
Outcome: Posterior rho -0.73 p=1.2e-9, Anterior -0.36 p=0.0095 vs date.
Interpretation: second animal, second instrument for the acquired edge effect
(R-009); magnitudes diluted as expected if within-half ordering is scrambled -
a wrong permutation cannot manufacture a time trend.

R-008.title: Fisk .ns3 reproduces band-matched .ns6 noise at rho 0.94-0.996, x1.19 scale
R-008.body:
What ran: six sessions spanning 2023-2025; .ns6 band-passed to the .ns3's own
corners and decimated.
Outcome: rank agreement ~0.99, stable x1.19 filter-shape scale; one sampled
.ns3 all-zero while its .ns6 is fine.
Interpretation: the stream is a redundant copy; grounds D-007.

R-009.title: Impedance edge effect is absent at the factory and grows in tissue (Fisk, paired bench anchor)
R-009.body:
What ran: border-vs-interior on Fisk in vivo (81 array-dates, map-free), 19
never-implanted factory arrays as control, two of them Fisk's own as paired
baselines; bank-B confound handled within-bank.
Outcome: in vivo -0.25 to -0.31 dex on 81/81 dates; factory null (p=0.47);
both arrays start at their bench value and open to -0.49 over a year.
Interpretation: replicates Forrest 2025's impedance finding with the
pre-implant control the paper lacks.

R-010.title: Treatment contrast is consistent only on the pedestal axis; coating and cortex axes reverse
R-010.body:
What ran: the same paired sessions contrasted three ways across Oops, Picasso,
Rocky I1; extended 2026-09-12 by Rocky I2's fourth arrangement (ant/post 1.152,
n=10).
Outcome: anterior/posterior >1 in all four arrangements; coated/uncoated and
medial/lateral reverse between animals.
Interpretation: the published claim's form (single-arrangement animals) cannot
separate coating from pedestal; central evidence for A-002.

R-011.title: Peri-shank NEUN deficit recovers by ~75-100 um and is worst near the surface
R-011.body:
What ran: the sibling histology session's NEUN pipeline on Nigel's lateral
TNP array - 18 sections chained across the 375-1800 um depth ladder, cpsam
segmentation validated at 99.2-99.6% against the lab's curated GUI run.
Outcome: every depth shows a NEUN deficit at 0-25 um from the hole edge
recovering by ~75-100 um; the near/plateau ratio rises 0.41 (375 um) ->
0.84 (1800 um, below most tips).
Interpretation: peri-shank neuronal loss is worst near the pad/surface. The
deferred (i,j)-to-CMP mapping in that pipeline is exactly what W-006 needs;
the depth profile bears on Q-002's insertion-trauma reading.

REF-001.title: Map of the preserved sorting results and how to inspect them
REF-001.summary: Layer-by-layer inventory (sorting-free, per-unit, spike trains, consensus, joins) with loaders and the figure-to-script-to-table trace
REF-001.body:
Written when the owner asked to dive into Rocky's data. Key grain facts: the
snippet-era methods keep per-unit metrics (spike membership re-derives from
NEVs); the 48-stem consensus subset keeps full spike trains as SI
numpy_folder; giant-event waveforms persist as npz shards. C1's previously
uncommitted figure code is now notebooks/scratch_consensus_figures.py.
MATLAB inspection layer added 2026-09-13: rocky_load_tables.m loads all
19 Rocky tables; rocky_reproduce_figures.m rebuilds the 27 derived-data
figures (verified against MATLAB R2025b); read_npy/read_npz_array read the
waveform shards, checked value-exact against NumPy.
